facts.text: Under the Stark County Scholars program, Malone University guarantees no out-of-pocket tuition for Stark County high school graduates with a 2.8+ GPA who demonstrate financial need and qualify for the Ohio College Opportunity Grant.

sources.title: One of the Most Affordable Colleges in Ohio - Malone University
sources.quote: If you graduated from a Stark County high school, demonstrate financial need, have a 2.8 or higher GPA, and qualify for the Ohio College Opportunity Grant, Malone will guarantee a no out-of-pocket tuition program.
